actor: ChatGPT · Control Room V11 scoped builder
user_delta: One Prometeo web surface for all pages/workspaces.
Human feedback captured directly as text, audio and attachments.
HACER/Trabajar in V11 queues existing Prometeo workers instead of opening ChatGPT by default.
Workers consume durable Page Change context, implement, persist CANDIDATE_READY RETURN, then a different worker independently verifies the candidate.
GitHub/source owners keep durable version/evidence history.
must_preserve: Control Room V10 remains byte-for-byte untouched as rollback baseline.
Universal Shell V5 keeps MANUAL_CHAT behavior unless the caller explicitly requests WORKER_POOL.
Current Tree, Semantic Registry, Organism, Work Context, current allocator/worker runtime and domain source owners retain authority.
No new scheduler, queue, worker family or CURRENT architecture.
Private capture literals, audio, attachment tokens and packet tokens never enter public GitHub frontier data.
Candidate != Human Accepted != Served; ACTIVE != liveness.
Existing concurrent Visual durable packages remain untouched.
Atomic existing claim/create remains execution authority.
Existing Page Change tables/storage are reused instead of inventing a duplicate feedback database.
WORKER_POOL builders cannot self-certify VERIFIED or SERVED; independent verifier identity must differ from builder identity.

source_owners.page_change: Supabase Edge prometeo-change-loop-v1 + existing prometeo_change_* / prometeo_execution_* tables

privacy_boundary.private_execution_context: loaded only after durable claim by an authorized worker through the connected Prometeo Supabase control plane
privacy_boundary.github_returns: sanitized result/evidence only; never raw private human captures

canary_gates: V11 loads when an optional RPC fails and exposes snapshot freshness.
Existing manual Page Change callers still open ChatGPT.
V11 WORKER_POOL creates READY execution work without a ChatGPT launch URL.
Public Page Change worker frontier contains no private packet payload.
Existing allocator merges Page Change work as an ordinary queue-ready candidate.
Worker claims before private packet retrieval.
Worker without required private-context capability does not execute.
Durable RETURN is ingested into the existing Page Change feed.
WORKER_POOL builder VERIFIED/SERVED claims are fenced to CANDIDATE_READY.
CANDIDATE_READY emits PAGE_CHANGE_VERIFY through the same allocator, not a second queue.
Builder worker_id is transported as a preclaim exclusion and the source builder cannot claim its verifier.
Only an independent PASS can upgrade the execution result to VERIFIED; FAIL/BLOCKED remain non-promoting.
Human review can accept/reject candidate without silently changing accepted baseline.

rollback.worker_runtime: remove Page Change frontier merge; ordinary existing lanes continue unchanged

promotion_gate: CONTROL_ROOM_V11 remains CANDIDATE until a real Page Change -> builder claim/private context -> CANDIDATE_READY RETURN -> independent verifier claim -> VERIFY PASS -> feed canary passes and the human explicitly promotes it.
